start.title: مهمة السيد
start.text:
إبراهيم شيخ. يضع يدك تحت فخذه.
«احلف بالرب — لا تأخذ لإسحاق زوجة من الكنعانيين.»

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Swear and accept the journey to his homeland
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You give your word. The journey begins in your heart.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Refuse — the road is too long for an old servant
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Abraham's eyes do not waver. The promise is heavier than the road.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Suggest a Canaanite girl from a wealthy house
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] "No," he says. "Not from this land. The Lord swore to my fathers."

refuse_consequence.title: الإيمان فوق الخوف
refuse_consequence.text:
إبراهيم يبتسم فقط. «الرب الذي أخذني من بيت أبي
سيرسل ملاكه أمامك.»

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Yield, and swear the oath
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You bow low. "I will go."

canaan_consequence.title: ليس من هذه الأرض
canaan_consequence.text:
«ابني يجب ألا يعود إلى هناك. لكنك حر من القسم
إذا لم تتبع المرأة.»

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Accept and swear properly
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You place your hand again, and swear by the Lord.

the_oath.title: عشرة جمال محملة
the_oath.text:
تأخذ عشرة جمال وأفضل بضائع سيدك.
الطريق إلى بلاد ما بين النهرين طويل. آرام النهرين تنتظر.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Set out at once with quiet trust
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You turn the caravan north. The desert opens before you.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Delay — gather more men and weapons first
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You linger over preparations. But faith does not wait on iron.

delay_consequence.title: الرب حارسك
delay_consequence.text:
تعود إليك كلمات إبراهيم: «ملاكه يذهب أمامك».
لا سيف تحمله يزن أكثر من هذا الوعد.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Set out in faith, with what you have
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You leave at first light. The camels' bells ring across the dunes.

the_well.title: بئر ناحور
the_well.text:
المساء. تصل إلى بئر حجري خارج مدينة ناحور.
وقت خروج النساء لاستقاء الماء.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Make the camels kneel and pray for a sign
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You bow your head beside the kneeling beasts. "O Lord, God of my master Abraham…"

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Walk into the city and ask for Nahor's house
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Strangers are wary. No one knows you. You return to the well, weary.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Pick the most beautiful girl you see
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Beauty is not the sign. Your master sent you for kindness, not a face.

city_consequence.title: العودة إلى البئر
city_consequence.text:
المدينة مغلقة أمام الغريب. البئر هو حيث يجيب الله.
تركع بجانب الجمال.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Pray for a sign instead
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] "Lord, give me success today," you whisper.

beauty_consequence.title: ليس ما تراه
beauty_consequence.text:
لم يرسلك سيدك لعيون الناس.
أرسلك للقلب الذي سيختاره الله.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Bow your head and ask for the true sign
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You forget the faces and pray instead.

the_prayer.title: العلامة التي تطلبها
the_prayer.text: ما هي العلامة التي ستضعها أمام الرب؟

choices.text: [TODO:ar] "She who offers to water my camels — let her be the one"
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The words are barely out of your mouth when a girl appears with a jar on her shoulder.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] "Send me a sign of fire from heaven"
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The sky stays still. God answers in kindness, not in flame.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] "The first one to greet me — let her be the one"
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] A greeting costs nothing. Your master needs a heart that gives.

fire_consequence.title: سماء هادئة
fire_consequence.text:
السماوات لا تزأر. إنها تنتظر.
علامة اختيار الله ستكون لطفًا صغيرًا، لا أعجوبة.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Ask instead for the one who waters the camels
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You change your prayer — and a girl steps from the city gate.

greeting_consequence.title: أكثر من الكلمات
greeting_consequence.text:
الكلمات سهلة. الخدمة هي القلب الذي يقرأه الله.
اطلب العلامة التي تكلف شيئًا.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Pray for the one who will water the camels
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You change the prayer — and look up.

rebekah_arrives.title: فتاة عند البئر
rebekah_arrives.text:
إنها شابة، حذرة، جميلة.
تملأ جرتها وتستدير لتغادر.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Run to her: "Please give me a little water from your jar"
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Your voice is humble. She stops and turns.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Order her to water your camels at once
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Her face hardens. She walks away without a word.

command_consequence.title: الكبرياء يبعدها
command_consequence.text:
لقد ذهبت. الجمال لا تزال عطشى.
يجب أن تنتظر — وتطلب من التالية بتواضع.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Wait, and ask the next girl gently
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] She returns again, having forgotten her sandal. You speak softly this time.

rebekah_pov_request.title: صوت غريب
rebekah_pov_request.text:
أنت رفقة، ابنة بتوئيل.
رجل عجوز مغبر عند البئر يطلب رشفة ماء.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] "Drink, my lord" — and offer to draw for his camels too
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You lower the jar to his hands. "I will draw for your camels also, until they have done."

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Give him only a sip and hurry home
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Your jar is heavy. But the camels watch you with tired, dust-rimmed eyes.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Refuse — your father warned you about strangers
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] He has not asked for much. A sip of water is no danger.

stingy_consequence.title: عيون الجمال
stingy_consequence.text:
عشرة جمال. أيام في الصحراء. عطشها هائل.
علمتك أمك أفضل من هذا.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Turn back and offer to water them all
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You return to the trough. "I will draw for your camels also."

refuse_water_consequence.title: رشفة ليست خطيئة
refuse_water_consequence.text:
إنه عجوز ومنحنٍ ومغبر. البئر هو مكان التجمع.
الضيافة هي شريعة شعبك.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Offer him drink — and the camels too
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You lift the jar. "Drink, my lord."

watering_camels.title: حتى يفرغوا
watering_camels.text:
تركض بين البئر والحوض حتى تؤلمك ذراعيك.
عشرة جمال تشرب حتى تشبع. الرجل العجوز يراقبك في صمت.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Finish the work fully, then ask if he needs more
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You set the empty jar down. He has not moved his eyes from you.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Stop halfway — surely that is enough
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The camels still murmur with thirst. The work is not done.

halfway_consequence.title: حتى يشرب الأخير
halfway_consequence.text:
الرب يراقب العمل الذي تم، لا الذي بدأ.
الجمال لا تزال تضغط بالقرب من الحوض.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Return to the well and finish
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You draw and pour until every beast turns away satisfied.

the_gifts.title: ذهب في يده
the_gifts.text:
يأخذ الخادم العجوز خاتمًا ذهبيًا ثقيلاً وسوارين.
"أخبريني — ابنة من أنتِ؟ هل يوجد مكان في بيت أبيكِ؟"

choices.text: [TODO:ar] "I am Bethuel's daughter — son of Milcah and Nahor"
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] His face changes. He bows his head to the ground at once.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Hide your name — he might be a thief
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] His kind eyes do not look like a thief's. The truth would have cost you nothing.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Take the gold and run home without answering
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You clutch the gold to your chest. But the man's voice follows you, gentle, unhurried.

hide_consequence.title: يد الرب واضحة
hide_consequence.text:
دموع الرجل تقول ما لا يستطيع لص تزييفه.
"مبارك الرب، إله سيدي إبراهيم،" يهمس.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Tell him your true name
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] "I am Rebekah, daughter of Bethuel, son of Milcah."

run_consequence.title: لم يظلمك
run_consequence.text:
إنه عجوز، وحيد، ويبكي فرحًا بجانب البئر.
هذا ليس لصًا. الرب في هذا اللقاء.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Return and tell him your name
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You walk back. "I am Rebekah, daughter of Bethuel."

the_blessing_well.title: مبارك الرب
the_blessing_well.text:
يحني رأسه إلى الأرض، باكيًا.
"مبارك الرب، الذي قادني إلى بيت إخوة سيدي."

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Run home and tell your mother's house everything
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You run, the gold catching the last sun. The house must hear of this.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Say nothing — keep the gold for yourself
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The Lord's hand cannot be hidden in a pocket. Your mother sees the gold at once.

secret_consequence.title: الذهب يتحدث عنك
secret_consequence.text:
الأساور تلمع على معصمك. أمك تلهث.
تطلب القصة كاملة.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Tell her everything truthfully
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Your brother Laban listens with widening eyes — and runs out toward the well.

laban_meets.title: لابان يدخله
laban_meets.text:
يركض أخوك لابان إلى البئر ويأتي بالرجل إلى البيت.
تُفرغ الجمال. ويُجلب الماء لغسل قدميه.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Set bread and wine before him at once
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Food is laid on the low table. He raises his hand: "I will not eat until I have told my errand."

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Demand to know his business first
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] His face stiffens. A guest is honored before he is questioned.

demand_consequence.title: أولاً الترحيب
demand_consequence.text:
يهز أبوك بتوئيل رأسه بلطف.
"الخبز أولاً. ثم كلامه."

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Set the table and listen properly
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You bring the bread. The lamp is lit. He begins to speak.

the_errand_told.title: أنا خادم إبراهيم
the_errand_told.text:
يروي كل شيء — القسم، الرحلة، الصلاة عند البئر،
كرمك، وعلامة الرب. الغرفة صامتة.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Bethuel and Laban speak: "This thing is from the Lord"
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] "We cannot speak to you bad or good. Take her, and let her be your master's son's wife."

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Refuse — the journey is too far, and he is a stranger
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The servant lifts his hands. "Hinder me not — the Lord has prospered my way."

stranger_consequence.title: الرب قد أنجح طريقه
stranger_consequence.text:
كل كلمة نطق بها تحمل بصمة يد الله.
من يستطيع أن يقف ضد ما اختاره الرب؟

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Bow to the will of the Lord
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Your father lifts his eyes. "Let it be as the Lord has said."

rebekahs_choice.title: هل تذهبين مع هذا الرجل؟
rebekahs_choice.text:
في الصباح يقول الخادم: "أرسلني إلى سيدي."
تسألك عائلتك: "دعها تبقى معنا بضعة أيام — عشرة على الأقل."
ثم يتوجهون إليك. "هل تذهبين مع هذا الرجل؟"

choices.text: [TODO:ar] "I will go."
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Two words. Quiet, certain. The whole house falls still.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] "Let me wait ten days at least"
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The servant's face is pleading. The Lord's hand has been on this from the first hour.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] "I will not leave my mother's house"
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Your mother lowers her eyes. The God who called Abraham is calling you now.

wait_consequence.title: الرب قد تكلم بالفعل
wait_consequence.text:
أُعطيت العلامة. أُعطي الذهب. فُتح الطريق.
ماذا تعني عشرة أيام أمام دعوة الله؟

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Change your answer — "I will go."
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You straighten. "I will go." Your nurse begins quietly to pack.

stay_consequence.title: بيت أكبر ينتظر
stay_consequence.text:
تأخذ أمك يدك. "يا ابنتي، الرب قد اختار.
اذهبي حيث يرسل. بركتنا معك."

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Answer at last: "I will go."
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You let her hand go. "I will go."

the_blessing_send.title: أم الألوف
the_blessing_send.text:
تباركك عائلتك عند الباب:
"كوني أم ألوف الملايين.
ليمتلك نسلك أبواب مبغضيهم."

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Mount the camel and ride out with the servant
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Your nurse Deborah climbs up beside you. The caravan turns south toward Canaan.

the_road_home.title: جنوبًا نحو كنعان
the_road_home.text:
تمتد الصحراء لأيام عديدة. يركب الخادم في المقدمة، يقظًا وهادئًا.
تشعرين بيد الرب في كل ميل.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Trust the journey and pray as you ride
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The wind moves the veil at your face. The sky deepens to evening.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Beg the servant to turn the caravan back
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] He shakes his head, kindly. "The Lord goes before us, my lady."

turn_back_consequence.title: إلى الأمام هو الطريق
turn_back_consequence.text:
لم يقُدك الرب إلى هذا الحد ليعيدك.
أرض الموعد تنتظرك، خلف التلال مباشرة.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Settle into the saddle and ride on
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You pull the veil closer. The caravan keeps moving.

isaac_in_field.title: رجل في الحقل
isaac_in_field.text:
في المساء ترين تلال النقب.
رجل يسير وحيدًا في الحقل، في وقت التأمل.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Ask the servant: "Who is this man?"
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] "It is my master," he says. You take your veil and cover your face.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Ride past — he is none of your business
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The servant gently raises his hand: "My lady — that is the man."

ride_past_consequence.title: هذا هو الرجل
ride_past_consequence.text:
يتوقف قلبك في صدرك.
تنزلقين من على الجمل وتضعين الحجاب على وجهك.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Walk forward to meet him
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Across the field, Isaac stops. He has been waiting longer than you know.

the_meeting.title: إسحاق ورفقة
the_meeting.text:
يروي الخادم لإسحاق كل ما حدث.
يُدخل إسحاقك إلى خيمة أمه سارة.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Stand with him beneath the open sky
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] He takes your hand. The wind is soft over the field of evening.

the_comfort.title: وأحبها
the_comfort.text:
أخذ إسحاق رفقة، وصارت زوجته.
وأحبها — وتعزى بعد موت أمه.
الوعد لإبراهيم يستمر، إلى جيل آخر.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Step into the story God has written
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The lamp glows in Sarah's tent. The covenant continues.
